title: Weinstein attends Ed Witten's first string theory lecture

tellings.quote: I happened by complete accident to be at the first lecture of Ed Whitten on string theory at the University of Pennsylvania in 1983

plain: In 1983, at the University of Pennsylvania, the physicist Ed Witten gave his first lecture on string theory, the idea in physics that the smallest pieces of matter are tiny vibrating strings. The researcher Eric Weinstein tells Michels he was in the room by complete accident, so he saw the start of the theory at first hand.
